_doc: perk_line: the one plain line on the Field Book card and the Boki tooltip (%s = the Summon key); card_lines: [from s, text], the plain line on the Field Book and Boki cards for a window of at least that many s (the last one reached). The Boki summon (KinSummon, decisions 0039, 0044, 0045): killed_cd_mult = cooldown x after a rival hunter kills it (a monster's kill counts as a rival's if a rival hurt it in the last rival_window_s s), home_speed = m/s the wisp flies home, reveal_s = s its owner shows to the killer squad; [window s, cooldown s] by the species' ai.role and body.size (briefs/boki-art/WISP_DESIGN_OPEN.md Q1), unless species has an entry for its id: times [window s, cooldown s] and why (one line from its dex identity), which wins (DECISIONS 2026-11-09 wisps: each Boki has its own). Uptime = window / (window + cooldown) stays in uptime_band.

cindle.why: Its venom keeps eating after the sting, so a short, sharp burst and a long wait.

puddlet.why: Its crystal shields and beams guard the squad, so it stays out the longest and rests long.

burrlet.why: Its spore clouds need time to set and root, so a middling window.

ermink.why: A blank-slate stoat that can grow into any of five lines, so it sits in the middle.

cairnback.why: A tortoise that carries its cairn, so it holds the line long and steady.

hivara.why: Its swarm and mantis blades strike fast and return soon, so a short window and a quick turnaround.

zephyrak.why: A swift sky serpent that flashes in and out, so the shortest window and the quickest return.

perk_line: Perks while it rides with you. Summon it (%s) for a few seconds: no perks while it is out.

steal._doc: Stolen Boki wisps (KinSteal, decision 0041, WISP_DESIGN_OPEN.md Q6/Q8): loose_s = s a downed hunter's wisp floats loose; grab_r = m reach, grab_s = s holding interact; carry_max = stolen wisps one hunter carries; passive_k = share of each stolen carry passive (summed with your own, clamped at the carry cap); summon_k = share of its window for the one stolen summon, at least summon_min_s s; extract_gems = gems paid for each stolen wisp the thief still carries when they extract alive (KinSteal.settle).
